ext_description.message: 地址栏或拖拽搜索，一键用两个搜索引擎打开原生分屏对比
ext_description.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store and chrome://extensions. [needs-translation]

engine_tpl_ok.description: Live hint under the URL template field in the engine dialog: the template can be used on either side of the split view. [needs-translation]

engine_tpl_right_only.message: 只能作右侧。可作左侧的网址要求：小写 %s 恰好出现一次，并且是某个查询参数的完整值（如 ?q=%s），该参数名只出现一次，网址不含 #
engine_tpl_right_only.description: Live hint under the URL template field: the template can only be used on the right side. Contains the full 'can be left side' rule; keep the rule wording identical to err_default_left_url. Do not translate %s, ?q=%s or #. [needs-translation]

err_bad_url.description: Error: the URL (template or trigger URL) cannot be parsed. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_no_placeholder.description: Error in the URL template field: the template lacks the lowercase %s placeholder. Do not translate %s. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_bad_scheme.message: 网址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
err_tpl_bad_scheme.description: Error in the URL template field: the template does not use http or https. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_no_host.description: Error in the URL template field: the template has no host name. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_wildcard_host.message: 域名不能包含 *，请填写具体的网站地址
err_tpl_wildcard_host.description: Error in the URL template field: the host name contains a * wildcard. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_ipv6.message: 不支持 IPv6 地址，请改用域名
err_tpl_ipv6.description: Error in the URL template field: the host is an IPv6 address literal. [needs-translation]

err_tpl_reserved_param.message: _ss 是保留参数，网址中不能包含它
err_tpl_reserved_param.description: Error in the URL template field: the template contains the reserved _ss parameter. Do not translate _ss. [needs-translation]

err_marker_format.description: Error page after a search: the _ss marker parameter in the trigger URL is malformed. [needs-translation]

err_unknown_engine.description: Error page after a search: the trigger URL names an engine id that does not exist (deleted or hidden). [needs-translation]

err_not_left.description: Error: the named engine's URL template cannot be used as the left side of a split view. [needs-translation]

err_template_mismatch.message: 触发网址与当前模板不一致，请到设置页重新复制
err_template_mismatch.description: Error page after a search: the trigger URL no longer matches the left engine's current template; the user must copy the trigger URL again from the settings page. [needs-translation]

err_config_too_large.description: Error when saving settings: one stored item exceeds chrome.storage.sync's per-item size limit. The placeholder is an internal storage key name (not translated). [needs-translation]

err_name_required.description: Error in the engine dialog: the name field is empty. [needs-translation]

err_name_too_long.message: 名称不能超过 $MAX$ 个字符
err_name_too_long.description: Error in the engine dialog: the name is longer than the maximum number of characters. [needs-translation]

err_id_format.message: id 只能由小写字母、数字和 - 组成，长度 1–20
err_id_format.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine id has invalid characters or length. [needs-translation]

err_id_taken.message: id “$ID$” 已被占用，请换一个
err_id_taken.description: Error in the engine dialog: another engine already uses this id. [needs-translation]

err_engine_gone.message: 找不到这个引擎，它可能已在其他设备上被删除
err_engine_gone.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine being edited no longer exists (probably deleted on another synced device). [needs-translation]

err_default_left_url.message: 不能保存：这个引擎是默认组合的左侧，而新网址不能作为左侧。可作左侧的网址要求：小写 %s 恰好出现一次，并且是某个查询参数的完整值（如 ?q=%s），该参数名只出现一次，网址不含 #。如果确实要用这个网址，请先把默认组合的左侧换成其他引擎。
err_default_left_url.description: Error in the engine dialog: the engine is the left side of the default pair and the new URL cannot be a left side. Contains the full 'can be left side' rule; keep the rule wording identical to engine_tpl_right_only. Do not translate %s, ?q=%s or #. [needs-translation]

err_only_preset_hide.message: 只有预置引擎可以隐藏
err_only_preset_hide.description: Error: only preset engines can be hidden. [needs-translation]

err_pair_uses_hide.message: 默认组合正在使用这个引擎，不能隐藏
err_pair_uses_hide.description: Error: the engine cannot be hidden because the default pair uses it. [needs-translation]

err_only_custom_delete.message: 只有自定义引擎可以删除
err_only_custom_delete.description: Error: only custom engines can be deleted. [needs-translation]

err_pair_uses_delete.message: 默认组合正在使用这个引擎，不能删除
err_pair_uses_delete.description: Error: the engine cannot be deleted because the default pair uses it. [needs-translation]

err_pair_missing.message: 所选引擎不存在，可能已被删除或隐藏
err_pair_missing.description: Error when setting the default pair: a selected engine no longer exists (deleted or hidden). [needs-translation]

err_quota_rate.message: 保存过于频繁，请稍后再试
err_quota_rate.description: Error when saving settings: chrome.storage.sync write rate limit reached. [needs-translation]

err_quota_bytes.message: 同步存储空间已满，请删除一些自定义引擎或缩短名称和网址后再试
err_quota_bytes.description: Error when saving settings: chrome.storage.sync total storage quota is full. [needs-translation]
